summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Formula Systems (1985) Ltd., a foreign private issuer, providing notice of its 2026 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders scheduled for July 20, 2026. The filing includes standard agenda items such as re-election of directors and re-appointment of auditors, along with presentation of audited financial statements. There are no special-situation events like acquisitions, divestitures, or management changes. The board recommends voting in favor of all proposals. This is a routine corporate housekeeping matter with no deal terms or strategic implications.
